threats.threat: a local or existential result is promoted to a universal, unique, or empirical claim
threats.control: typed claim scope, quantifier, evidence tier, promotion check, and visible nonpromotion

threats.threat: a GMUT gauge choice is promoted as a physical observable
threats.control: action, gauge group, gauge condition, residual transform, observable, and invariance obligations

threats.threat: a bounded damping experiment is called global constraint stability or physical validation
threats.control: frozen damping region, propagation checks, and zero-real-observation boundary

threats.threat: THOS intercurrent events or estimand strategies are selected after observing outcomes
threats.control: preregistered estimand attributes, events, strategies, contrast, analysis set, and missing-data policy

threats.threat: pairwise subject identifiers are treated as universally unlinkable
threats.control: verifier scope, audience binding, minimization, nonce separation, and explicit collusion boundary

threats.threat: synthetic identity fixtures are promoted to production privacy or interoperability
threats.control: real-key, resolver, status, cross-vendor, review, and governance gates

threats.threat: repository output decides collective data purpose, taonga use, or benefit-sharing authority
threats.control: neutral questions and exact affected-party, Māori, cultural, and legal gates

threats.threat: bidirectional controls create a misleading visual order or hidden spoof
threats.control: codepoint inventory, control classification, balance check, visual-order comparison, witness retention, and quarantine

threats.threat: an inferred accessible name conflicts with hidden references or duplicate labels
threats.control: source provenance, precedence, hidden-reference, conflict, empty-name, and language checks

threats.threat: maximum-entropy inference is silently equated with thermodynamic entropy
threats.control: constraint, reference-measure, units, preconditions, and cross-domain non-substitution

threats.threat: a synthetic pairwise-identifier check is called live cross-vendor collusion evidence
threats.control: open gap requiring independent vendors, live keys, consent, privacy, and security review

threats.threat: automated name or bidi checks are described as affected-user evidence
threats.control: explicit manual and affected-user reservations with zero participants

threats.threat: same-owner snapshots are called independent evidence
threats.control: owner, protocol, infrastructure, and return provenance

threats.threat: a bounded privacy scan is called exhaustive
threats.control: declared pattern classes and manual review boundary

boundary: Bounded repository engineering evidence only. GMUT remains a typed scalar-tensor/EFT research-model family, not an established force, unique prediction, likelihood result, empirical confirmation, proof, final physics, or Theory of Everything. THOS remains proxy without preregistered blind matched-budget real arms, real participants and raters, and independent review. No production Freed ID, CBR legitimacy, affected-party acceptance, Māori wording or authority, Māori data governance, cultural ratification, legal interpretation, enacted-law status, deployment, exhaustive security, complete accessibility, independent-team reproduction, AGI/ASI, consciousness, sentience, personhood, proof/canon, sibling merge, or Stage 20 readiness is established.
